9	import '../../../capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart';
10	import '../../../capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart';
11	import '../../../capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart';
12	import '../cubit/chat_cubit.dart';
13	import '../cubit/chat_state.dart';
14	import '../widgets/chat_bubble.dart';
15	
16	/// Tela 1 — Home/Chat, RF04's first real (non-placeholder) screen: the
17	/// same dark-green header + drawer chrome the deleted
18	/// `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` used, now with a real message list and
19	/// composer. [cubit] is injected rather than resolved internally
20	/// (`sl<ChatCubit>()` stays the router's own job, Code Map), so a test can
21	/// pass a fake-repository-backed instance directly.
22	class ChatScreen extends StatefulWidget {
23	  const ChatScreen({required this.cubit, super.key});
24	
25	  final ChatCubit cubit;
26	
27	  @override
28	  State<ChatScreen> createState() => _ChatScreenState();
29	}
30	
31	class _ChatScreenState extends State<ChatScreen> {
32	  final _textController = TextEditingController();
33	  final _scrollController = ScrollController();
34	  final _composerFocusNode = FocusNode();
35	
36	  /// The last [ChatReady.sessionId] this screen has already reacted to —
37	  /// `null` until the very first [ChatReady] (bootstrap). Distinguishes
38	  /// "the active session just changed" (spec-6-2: `switchSession`/
39	  /// `startNewSession`, or the initial bootstrap) from an ordinary
40	  /// in-session update (a streamed token, a bookmark state change) that
41	  /// happens to carry the same [ChatReady.restoreScrollOffset] value
42	  /// forward via `copyWith` — only the former should ever trigger a
43	  /// scroll jump or request composer focus.
44	  String? _lastSessionId;
45	
46	  @override
47	  void initState() {
48	    super.initState();
49	    // `ChatCubit.init()`'s own no-op guard makes this safe to call on
50	    // every mount (Boundaries: "silently ensure one Chat Session exists").
51	    widget.cubit.init();
52	    _scrollController.addListener(_recordScrollOffset);
53	  }
54	
55	  @override
56	  void dispose() {
57	    _scrollController.removeListener(_recordScrollOffset);
58	    _textController.dispose();
59	    _scrollController.dispose();
60	    _composerFocusNode.dispose();
61	    super.dispose();
62	  }
63	
64	  /// Boundaries: "Scroll-offset restore is in-memory only, keyed by
65	  /// `sessionId`, on `ChatCubit`" — this is the one listener that keeps
66	  /// it current, firing on every scroll update while a session is active.
67	  void _recordScrollOffset() {
68	    final state = widget.cubit.state;
69	    if (state is ChatReady && _scrollController.hasClients) {
70	      widget.cubit.recordScrollOffset(
71	        state.sessionId,
72	        _scrollController.position.pixels,
73	      );
74	    }
75	  }
76	
77	  void _send() {
78	    final text = _textController.text;
79	    if (text.trim().isEmpty) {
80	      return;
81	    }
82	    widget.cubit.sendMessage(text);
83	    _textController.clear();
84	  }
85	
86	  /// Only jumps to the bottom when the view was already there (or close
87	  /// to it) *before* this update, or hasn't attached to a scrollable yet
88	  /// (the very first history render) — otherwise a user who deliberately
89	  /// scrolled up to reread earlier history would get yanked back down on
90	  /// every single streamed token.
91	  void _scrollToBottomSoon() {
92	    if (_scrollController.hasClients) {
93	      final position = _scrollController.position;
94	      const nearBottomThreshold = 80.0;
95	      final wasNearBottom =
96	          position.maxScrollExtent - position.pixels <= nearBottomThreshold;
97	      if (!wasNearBottom) {
98	        return;
99	      }
100	    }
101	    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
102	      if (_scrollController.hasClients) {
103	        _scrollController.jumpTo(_scrollController.position.maxScrollExtent);
104	      }
105	    });
106	  }
107	
108	  /// I/O matrix: "Switch session" — jumps to [offset] once the just-built
109	  /// history has attached to a scrollable, clamped to the actual
110	  /// `maxScrollExtent` in case the recorded offset no longer fits (a
111	  /// shorter history than when it was recorded).
112	  void _jumpToOffset(double offset) {
113	    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
114	      if (_scrollController.hasClients) {
115	        final maxExtent = _scrollController.position.maxScrollExtent;
116	        _scrollController.jumpTo(offset.clamp(0, maxExtent));
117	      }
118	    });
119	  }
120	
121	  /// Acceptance Criteria: "Given I tap 'Novo Chat' ... it opens empty,
122	  /// composer focused" — called whenever a session switch (new or past)
123	  /// lands on zero messages, per the listener's own `state.messages.
124	  /// isEmpty` guard below; a brand new session is always empty, so this
125	  /// satisfies the AC, but an empty *past* session switched back into
126	  /// would trigger it too (harmless — focusing the composer on an empty
127	  /// conversation is never wrong, just not the literal scenario the AC
128	  /// names).
129	  void _focusComposerSoon() {
130	    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
131	      if (mounted) {
132	        _composerFocusNode.requestFocus();
133	      }
134	    });
135	  }
136	
137	  @override
138	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
139	    return BlocProvider<ChatCubit>.value(
140	      value: widget.cubit,
141	      child: Scaffold(
142	        backgroundColor: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceBg,
143	        drawer: const AppDrawer(),
144	        // Boundaries: "heavier drawer scrim rgba(36,31,25,.4)" — overrides
145	        // `Scaffold`'s own default barrier, same convention the deleted
146	        // `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` already used.
147	        drawerScrimColor: DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy,
148	        body: Column(
149	          children: [
150	            const _ChatHeader(),
151	            // spec-6-3 — the offline banner, visible for the lifetime of
152	            // `ChatReady.isOffline`; renders nothing otherwise. Sits
153	            // between the header and the message list (Code Map) so
154	            // history stays fully visible/scrollable underneath it
155	            // (Boundaries).
156	            BlocBuilder<ChatCubit, ChatState>(
157	              builder: (context, state) => state is ChatReady && state.isOffline
158	                  ? const _OfflineBanner()
159	                  : const SizedBox.shrink(),
160	            ),
161	            Expanded(
162	              child: BlocConsumer<ChatCubit, ChatState>(
163	                listener: (context, state) {
164	                  if (state is! ChatReady) {
165	                    return;
166	                  }
167	                  final isNewSession = state.sessionId != _lastSessionId;
168	                  _lastSessionId = state.sessionId;
169	                  if (!isNewSession) {
170	                    _scrollToBottomSoon();
171	                    return;
172	                  }
173	                  final restoreScrollOffset = state.restoreScrollOffset;
174	                  if (restoreScrollOffset != null) {
175	                    _jumpToOffset(restoreScrollOffset);
176	                  } else {
177	                    _scrollToBottomSoon();
178	                  }
179	                  if (state.messages.isEmpty) {
180	                    _focusComposerSoon();
181	                  }
182	                },
183	                builder: (context, state) => switch (state) {
184	                  ChatBootstrapLoading() => const Center(
185	                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(
186	                      color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
187	                    ),
188	                  ),
189	                  ChatBootstrapError(failure: final failure) =>
190	                    _ChatBootstrapErrorView(failure: failure),
191	                  ChatReady(messages: final messages) => ListView.builder(
192	                    controller: _scrollController,
193	                    padding: DesignTokens.screenPadding,
194	                    itemCount: messages.length,
195	                    itemBuilder: (context, index) => ChatBubble(
196	                      key: ValueKey(messages[index].id),
197	                      message: messages[index],
198	                      // spec-6-3 — only a `failed` AI bubble ever renders
199	                      // the tap-to-retry copy at all (`ChatBubble`'s own
200	                      // guard), so wiring this unconditionally on every
201	                      // bubble is harmless.
202	                      onRetry: () =>
203	                          widget.cubit.retryMessage(messages[index].id),
204	                    ),
205	                  ),
206	                },
207	              ),
208	            ),
209	            _ChatComposer(
210	              controller: _textController,
211	              focusNode: _composerFocusNode,
212	              onSend: _send,
213	            ),
214	          ],
215	        ),
216	      ),
217	    );
218	  }
219	}
220	
221	/// The same dark-green header + ☰-opens-drawer wiring the deleted
222	/// `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` used — moved here verbatim rather than
223	/// shared from a common widget, since that screen is deleted wholesale
224	/// (Code Map) and no third screen needs this exact header yet.
225	class _ChatHeader extends StatelessWidget {
226	  const _ChatHeader();
227	
228	  @override
229	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
230	    return Container(
231	      color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
232	      padding: DesignTokens.navHeaderPadding,
233	      child: Builder(
234	        builder: (context) => Row(
235	          children: [
236	            GestureDetector(
237	              onTap: () => Scaffold.of(context).openDrawer(),
238	              child: const Icon(
239	                Icons.menu,
240	                size: DesignTokens.navMenuIconSize,
241	                color: DesignTokens.colorOnPrimary,
242	              ),
243	            ),
244	            Expanded(
245	              child: Text(
246	                'Cerne',
247	                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
248	                style: DesignTokens.textTitleLg.copyWith(
249	                  color: DesignTokens.colorOnPrimary,
250	                ),
251	              ),
252	            ),
253	            const SizedBox(width: DesignTokens.navMenuIconSize),
254	          ],
255	        ),
256	      ),
257	    );
258	  }
259	}
260	
261	/// I/O matrix: "Bootstrap failure" — a generic error state, not an
262	/// infinite spinner; no retry action exists yet (Boundaries: the
263	/// retry-tap action belongs to Story 6.2–6.5).
264	class _ChatBootstrapErrorView extends StatelessWidget {
265	  const _ChatBootstrapErrorView({required this.failure});
266	
267	  final Failure failure;
268	
269	  @override
270	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
271	    return Center(
272	      child: Padding(
273	        padding: DesignTokens.screenPadding,
274	        child: Column(
275	          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,

279	              size: DesignTokens.spacing2xl,

297	/// spec-6-3 Boundaries — a full-width band between `_ChatHeader` and the
298	/// message list, `Icons.wifi_off` + `colorInfoOffline`/`colorOnPrimary`

3	import '../../../../core/design_tokens.dart';
4	import '../../domain/entities/chat_message.dart';
5	import '../cubit/chat_state.dart';
6	
7	/// Review finding: shared by the `Semantics.label` and the visible `Text`
8	/// below so a future copy edit can't desync the spoken label from what's
9	/// actually on screen.
10	const _retryCopy = 'Falha ao gerar resposta — toque para tentar novamente';
11	
12	/// One message bubble — user (Boundaries: `colorChatBubbleUser`, squared
13	/// bottom-right corner) vs AI (`colorSurfaceElevated`, squared bottom-left
14	/// corner, resting [DesignTokens.elevation1]). Exactly the 3 visible
15	/// states RF04's Acceptance Criteria names render here, driven by
16	/// [ChatUiMessage.status]: `streaming` (progressive text + blinking
17	/// cursor), `failed` (spec-6-3: a tappable tap-to-retry indicator replaces
18	/// the timestamp slot, invoking [onRetry]), `complete` (plain text,
19	/// nothing else). [ChatUiMessage.content] itself is rendered as-is in
20	/// every state — never cleared on failure (I/O matrix).
21	class ChatBubble extends StatefulWidget {
22	  const ChatBubble({required this.message, this.onRetry, super.key});
23	
24	  final ChatUiMessage message;
25	
26	  /// spec-6-3 — invoked when the user taps a `failed` AI bubble's own
27	  /// retry copy; `null` on a user bubble (never shown there, only an AI
28	  /// response ever fails) or whenever a caller has nothing to wire it to.
29	  final VoidCallback? onRetry;
30	
31	  @override
32	  State<ChatBubble> createState() => _ChatBubbleState();
33	}
34	
35	class _ChatBubbleState extends State<ChatBubble>
36	    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
37	  late final AnimationController _cursorController;
38	
39	  @override
40	  void initState() {
41	    super.initState();
42	    _cursorController = AnimationController(
43	      vsync: this,
44	      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 600),
45	    );
46	    _syncCursorAnimation();
47	  }
48	
49	  @override
50	  void didUpdateWidget(ChatBubble oldWidget) {
51	    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
52	    _syncCursorAnimation();
53	  }
54	
55	  /// Keeps the ticker running only while actually needed — a message
56	  /// that finalizes to `complete`/`failed` must stop ticking forever
57	  /// after, both so a long-lived chat session never leaks one live
58	  /// `AnimationController` per past message, and so nothing waiting on
59	  /// "every animation in the tree has settled" (e.g. a test's own
60	  /// `pumpAndSettle()`) ever blocks on a bubble that finished streaming.
61	  void _syncCursorAnimation() {
62	    final shouldAnimate = widget.message.status == ChatMessageStatus.streaming;
63	    if (shouldAnimate && !_cursorController.isAnimating) {
64	      _cursorController.repeat(reverse: true);
65	    } else if (!shouldAnimate && _cursorController.isAnimating) {
66	      _cursorController.stop();
67	    }
68	  }
69	
70	  @override
71	  void dispose() {
72	    _cursorController.dispose();
73	    super.dispose();
74	  }
75	
76	  @override
77	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
78	    final message = widget.message;
79	    final onRetry = widget.onRetry;
80	    final isUser = message.role == ChatMessageRole.user;
81	    // Boundaries: "cursor skipped under
82	    // `MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations`" — the real token text
83	    // itself always reveals as real tokens actually arrive (there is no
84	    // separate typing-speed animation to collapse here), only the
85	    // blinking-cursor glyph is conditional on Reduce Motion.
86	    final reduceMotion = MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations;
87	    final showCursor =
88	        message.status == ChatMessageStatus.streaming && !reduceMotion;
89	
90	    // spec-6-3 Boundaries: tap-to-retry copy, tappable, 44pt min tap
91	    // target — replaces the earlier generic (non-tappable) error
92	    // indicator. The visible copy renders identically either way;
93	    // `Semantics(button: true)` only wraps it when [onRetry] is actually
94	    // supplied (review finding) — a bubble built with no retry callback
95	    // must never be announced to a screen reader as a working button.
96	    final retryIndicator = InkWell(
97	      onTap: onRetry,
98	      borderRadius: const BorderRadius.all(
99	        Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm),
100	      ),
101	      child: ConstrainedBox(
102	        constraints: const BoxConstraints(
103	          minHeight: DesignTokens.insertionModalTapTargetMin,
104	        ),
105	        child: Container(
106	          alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
107	          padding: DesignTokens.chatFailureIndicatorPadding,
108	          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
109	            color: DesignTokens.colorErrorBg,
110	            borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(
111	              Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm),
112	            ),
113	          ),
114	          child: Text(
115	            _retryCopy,
116	            style: DesignTokens.textCaptionSm.copyWith(
117	              color: DesignTokens.colorError,
118	            ),
119	          ),
120	        ),
121	      ),
122	    );
123	    final retryIndicatorWithSemantics = onRetry == null
124	        ? retryIndicator
125	        : Semantics(
126	            button: true,
127	            label: _retryCopy,
128	            excludeSemantics: true,
129	            child: retryIndicator,
130	          );
131	
132	    return Align(
133	      alignment: isUser ? Alignment.centerRight : Alignment.centerLeft,
134	      child: Container(
135	        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: DesignTokens.chatBubbleGap),
136	        constraints: BoxConstraints(
137	          maxWidth:
138	              MediaQuery.of(context).size.width *
139	              DesignTokens.chatBubbleMaxWidthFraction,
140	        ),
141	        padding: DesignTokens.chatBubblePadding,
142	        decoration: BoxDecoration(
143	          color: isUser
144	              ? DesignTokens.colorChatBubbleUser
145	              : DesignTokens.colorSurfaceElevated,
146	          borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
147	            topLeft: const Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusMd),
148	            topRight: const Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusMd),
149	            bottomLeft: Radius.circular(isUser ? DesignTokens.radiusMd : 0),
150	            bottomRight: Radius.circular(isUser ? 0 : DesignTokens.radiusMd),
151	          ),
152	          boxShadow: isUser ? null : DesignTokens.elevation1,
153	        ),
154	        child: Column(
155	          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
156	          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
157	          children: [
158	            Text.rich(
159	              TextSpan(
160	                children: [
161	                  TextSpan(text: message.content),
162	                  if (showCursor)
163	                    WidgetSpan(
164	                      alignment: PlaceholderAlignment.middle,
165	                      child: ExcludeSemantics(
166	                        child: FadeTransition(
167	                          opacity: _cursorController,
168	                          child: const Text('▏'),
169	                        ),
170	                      ),
171	                    ),
172	                ],
173	              ),
174	              style: DesignTokens.textBodyLg.copyWith(
175	                color: DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary,
176	              ),
177	            ),
178	            if (message.status == ChatMessageStatus.failed) ...[
179	              const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingXs),
180	              retryIndicatorWithSemantics,
181	            ],
182	          ],
183	        ),
184	      ),
185	    );
186	  }

Its own spec's review-findings list was already fully checked off with unit/widget/datasource-tier regression tests, but `chat_flow_e2e_test.dart` (the real-pipeline tier) had none of it: no test drove `retryMessage()` through the real `chat-messages-retry` endpoint, and no test ever pushed a live event through the real `connectivity_plus` event channel — `connectivityEventChannel` was mocked with an empty `setMockMethodCallHandler` stub that could never actually deliver a reading, and was also declared as the wrong channel type (`MethodChannel` instead of `EventChannel`, invisible until a real stream-push was attempted).
+
+## Generated Tests
+
+### E2E Tests (real pipeline, faked HTTP transport + native channels only)
+
+- [x] `test/features/chat/chat_flow_e2e_test.dart` — 4 new cases, plus one fixture fix:
+  - Fixed `connectivityEventChannel`'s declared type (`MethodChannel` → `EventChannel`) and its mock from `setMockMethodCallHandler` (a no-op stub) to `setMockStreamHandler`/`MockStreamHandler.inline`, capturing the live `MockStreamHandlerEventSink` so a test can actually push a connectivity reading — added an `emitConnectivity()` helper that pushes one event and flushes the 5 microtask hops between the fake channel and `ChatCubit`'s own listener.
+  - "tap-to-retry ... regenerates that exact bubble in place through the real chat-messages-retry endpoint" — `message_created` arrives then the stream drops; `retryMessage()` is called directly against the real DI-resolved cubit; asserts the same bubble id/position goes `failed` → `complete` with no new bubble pair, and the real request hits `chat-messages-retry/{sessionId}/{serverId}` (`UrlBuilder`-built).
+  - "tap-to-retry ... falls back to a full chat-messages-send resend ... never calls chat-messages-retry with no serverId" — stream drops before `message_created` ever arrives; asserts the fallback resend lands in the same bubble slot and no request ever touches `chat-messages-retry`.
+  - "a live 'offline' reading ... flips ChatReady.isOffline to true" — pushes `['none']` through the real event-channel pipeline.
+  - "connectivity returning flips ChatReady.isOffline back to false" — same pipeline, `['none']` then `['wifi']`.
+
+## Verification
+
+- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues (project-wide)
+- `fvm flutter test` — 971/971 passed (full suite, including all 4 new cases)
+
+## Coverage
+
+- Story 6.3's 4 acceptance criteria (retry-in-place, offline composer lock, offline "Novo Chat" disable via drawer-level widget tests already in place, connectivity recovery) now each have real-pipeline-tier proof for the two that are cubit/network-shaped (retry, connectivity toggling); the two that are pure-widget-shaped (composer/drawer disabling) remain correctly covered at the widget tier only, matching this project's existing altitude convention.
+- Closed a latent gap in the existing fixture itself (the mistyped `EventChannel`/`setMockMethodCallHandler` combination), which meant no prior test — including this story's own dev-authored ones — could ever have exercised a real connectivity change end-to-end; `fvm flutter analyze` catching the type mismatch only after the mock call was switched to `setMockStreamHandler` suggests the old stub was silently inert.
+
+## Next Steps
+
+- Not covered here: a flapping-connectivity e2e case (rapid on/off/on) — already logged in spec-6-3 as a deferred, pre-existing architectural trade-off, not a gap introduced by this run.
+- No device/simulator or CI exists yet; revisit true on-device E2E once one is introduced (per `AGENTS.md`).

content.text:
Found it. Dio applies a per-chunk receive-timeout (`BaseOptions.receiveTimeout`, 30s, set globally in `injection_container.dart:63`) to every response stream — including the chat SSE stream — restarting on each chunk but firing if any gap between chunks (even the gap before the very first chunk) exceeds 30s. A RAG+LLM backend can easily take longer than that before it flushes `message_created`/first `token`. When that happens, dio aborts the connection client-side with a timeout, `_consumeSse`/`ApiClient` surface it as a `Left`, and the bubble is marked `failed` — even though the backend keeps running server-side and persists the full answer (which is why it reappears on reload). Then, since `message_created` was never received, `retryMessage` has no `serverId` and falls back to a full `sendMessage` resend each tap, creating a new persisted user message every time — explaining both the stuck failure note and the duplicated questions.

The backend's own documented circuit-breaker for a slow generation is the in-band `AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT` SSE `error` event (already handled correctly by `_parseEvent`), so the client doesn't need its own aggressive per-chunk timeout racing against it on this one streaming call. I'll disable dio's receive-timeout specifically for `postStream`, leaving it in place for every other (non-streaming) call.

All 971 tests pass and `flutter analyze` reports zero issues.

## Root cause

Dio applies `BaseOptions.receiveTimeout` (set to 30s for the whole app, `injection_container.dart:63`) as a **per-chunk** gap timer, even on `ResponseType.stream` requests — it restarts on every received chunk, including the gap before the very first one (confirmed in dio 5.11.1's `response_stream_handler.dart`). That's a sane default for ordinary JSON calls, but it's far too aggressive for the SSE chat stream: when the RAG+LLM pipeline takes more than 30s to flush `message_created`/the next `token` (easily possible with retrieval + generation latency), dio aborts the connection client-side with a timeout — while the backend, unaware the client gave up, keeps running and persists the full answer regardless.

That explains the whole chain:
- The bubble gets marked `failed` for an answer the backend actually finished — hence it shows complete after leaving and returning.
- If the abort happens before `message_created` ever arrived, the user message's `serverId` stays `null`.
- `retryMessage` then falls back to a full `sendMessage` resend (by design, for the case where the backend genuinely never saw the message) — but here the backend *did* persist it, so every retry tap creates a brand-new duplicate user message, and since the same latency pattern recurs, the retry's own stream can time out the same way, leaving the failure note stuck.

## Fix

[api_client.dart:108-136](lib/core/network/api_client.dart#L108-L136) — `postStream` now explicitly overrides `receiveTimeout: Duration.zero` (disabling dio's per-chunk gap timer) for this one streaming call, leaving the 30s default untouched for every other `ApiClient` method. The backend's own `AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT` in-band SSE `error` event (already mapped by `_parseEvent`) remains the real circuit-breaker for a generation that's genuinely stuck, so no client-side receive-gap timeout is needed on top of it.

content.content:
# Cerne — Prototype extract

The visual reference of the product is `cerne-prototype.html` (this folder). Open it in a browser; it needs JavaScript. This extract lists its navigable states, its visual tokens, its components and the implementation notes that come with it.

- **Frame:** 390 × 844 logical points, portrait only, 4 dp grid.
- **Language of the interface:** Portuguese. Every UI text below appears exactly as in the prototype, in quotes.
- **Precedence:** the prototype defines appearance and states. Behavior rules (triggers, timings, filters, error handling) are defined in `docs/input/requirements.md`; where the prototype's simulated behavior differs from a requirement, the requirement prevails.

---

## 1. Navigation map

The prototype has **32 navigable states**, reachable from a single state machine (a `screen` variable plus overlay flags). Not every state is a new full screen — several are **overlays** (modal, sheet, bottom sheet, dialog) shown on top of one of three base screens: **Home/Chat**, **Meus Registros** and **Configurações**. Overlays preserve the screen underneath (it stays visible, with a darkened scrim behind).

```
Splash (auto, 1.8 s)
  └─> Biometria ──tap/error──> PIN inicial / PIN após falha
  │      └─> "usar e-mail e senha" ──> Entrar / criar conta (toggle)
  │                                          └─> submit ──> Home/Chat
  └─(PIN complete, 4 digits)──> Home/Chat
  └─(Face ID/Touch ID ok)──> Home/Chat

Home/Chat (base screen)
  ├─ overlay: Sessão expirada (backend session expires; "Entrar novamente" ──> Biometria)
  ├─ overlay: side menu (☰ icon) ──> Meus Registros | Planos de Ação | Configurações | new conversation
  └─ overlay: Insertion modal ("+" button) ──> tabs Texto / Áudio / Foto, each with its own sub-states
        (on save, the modal closes and returns to Home/Chat with the record added)

Meus Registros (base screen, from the side menu)
  ├─ empty state (no records) ──CTA "Criar primeiro registro"──> Insertion modal
  ├─ overlay: filter sheet ──"Aplicar"──> active filters (chips on the list)
  └─ overlay: export card (download icon) ──> pending ──> processing ──> done | error | empty period

Planos de Ação (base screen, from the side menu) — static screen, 3-column kanban (extension, not implemented)

Configurações (base screen, from the side menu)
  ├─ dashboard variations: zero entries | one entry | more than 30 (with narrative) | narrative unavailable
  ├─ inline profile-name editing
  ├─ AI persona selection (Analítico / Empático / Socrático) (extension, not implemented)
  ├─ "Sair" ──> Biometria
  └─ overlay: account-deletion confirmation ──"Apagar tudo"──> Biometria (same destination as logout)
```

---

## 2. Navigable states

Names as they appear in the prototype. The prototype's own state catalog has 32 entries: Tela 0 — Splash; Tela 0.1 — Biometria; Tela 0.1a — Entrar / criar conta; Tela 0.1b — PIN inicial; Tela 0.1c — PIN após falha; Tela 1 — Home / Chat; Tela 2 — Texto, Áudio (Gravando, Processando, Transcrito, Erro), Foto (Captura, Processando OCR, Reconhecido, Erro); Tela 3 — Menu lateral; Tela 1 — Sessão expirada; Tela 4 — Meus Registros, Estado vazio, Sheet de filtro, Filtros ativos; Exportar — Pendente, Processando, Concluído, Erro, Período vazio; Tela 5 — Planos de Ação **[ext]**; Tela 6 — Configurações, Dashboard zero entradas, Dashboard uma entrada, Narrativa indisponível, Confirmar exclusão. The tables below group them by screen; some rows describe variations inside one state (e.g., the bookmark sub-states, the streaming response). Extension states (requirements, section 2) are marked **[ext]**.

### 2.1 Entry and authentication
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Tela 0 — Splash | Wordmark "Cerne" centered on dark green, 3 loading dots; lasts 1.8 s and moves on automatically. |
| Tela 0.1 — Biometria | Fingerprint circle, title "Toque para desbloquear", link "Usar PIN", secondary link "usar e-mail e senha" near the bottom. |
| Tela 0.1a — Entrar | Login mode: title "Bem-vindo de volta", fields E-mail and Senha, CTA "Entrar", toggle link, link "usar biometria". |
| Tela 0.1a — Criar conta | Same screen in sign-up mode: title "Crie sua conta", CTA "Criar conta" (toggled by a text link, not a separate screen). |
| Tela 0.1b — PIN inicial | Title "Digite seu PIN", 4 progress dots, 3×4 numeric keypad with backspace; after the 4th digit, moves on after 350 ms. |
| Tela 0.1c — PIN após falha | Same as 0.1b plus the error band "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN". |

### 2.2 Conversation
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|

## 4. Special states that need extra care

- **Expired session:** an overlay on the chat that keeps history and scroll position — the expired token must not discard the conversation state in memory before re-authentication. Re-authenticating goes back to the Biometria screen, not to a full form.
- **Offline:** blocks **sending new messages** (send icon disabled, explanatory banner), but **history stays visible and navigable**. The prototype does not show what happens to the insertion modal (text/audio/photo) when offline.
- **Asynchronous processing — audio transcription:** a loading state (spinner + frozen waveform) and two outcomes (success/error); the error always offers "Tentar novamente" and never loses the recorded audio.
- **Asynchronous processing — photo OCR:** same pattern as audio, with one extra exit on error: "Salvar só a foto", which saves the record even without extracted text.
- **Asynchronous processing — export:** two loading stages (preparing → generating the AI summary) before the result; on error, the raw data is always available for download — the failure is isolated to the AI narrative, never to the user's data.
- **Dashboard narrative unavailable:** the chart loads normally but the AI summary paragraph fails — distinct from "zero entries" (lack of data) and needs its own error message.

## 5. Implementation notes

1. **"29 frames" vs. "32 states":** the prototype has 32 distinct navigable states, but the number of frames (29) suggests that some state families should be one screen with internal state, not separate routes (e.g., a single `ExportSheet` with a status enum instead of 5 routes). Consider this when designing navigation.
2. **Account deletion without a success screen:** both "Sair" and "Apagar tudo" return to the Biometria screen; there is no "account deleted" or "you signed out" screen.
3. **Login vs. sign-up:** the same screen toggled by a text link; the prototype shows no extra sign-up fields (e.g., password confirmation, name). Whether sign-up needs extra fields is a product decision not covered visually.
4. **Insertion modal when offline:** not represented.
5. **Switching tabs in the insertion modal:** opening the modal always resets every tab to `idle`/empty, but switching tabs *during* a modal session is not cleared automatically — the expected behavior (e.g., whether an ongoing recording is discarded on tab switch) is not defined by the prototype.
6. **Per-entry sync indicator:** the states "sincronizado / sincronizando / erro de sync" exist visually on the cards, but no explicit "retry sync" action is shown for the error state. The semantics of the badge are in `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`.
7. **Text search combined with filters:** the filter sheet and the text search are on the same screen, but the prototype does not show them acting together.

| `textBodyLg` | Karla 400 · 16/24 | Bubbles, entries |
| `textBodyMd` | Karla 400 · 14/20 | Secondary text and descriptions |
| `textLabelMd` | Karla 500 · 13/18 | Button text, chips |
| `textMonoCaption` | IBM Plex Mono 500 · 12/16 · letter-spacing .2 | Technical metadata (timestamps, counters, status labels) |

### Spacing (4 dp grid)
`spacingXs` 4 · `spacingSm` 8 · `spacingMd` 16 · `spacingLg` 24 · `spacingXl` 32 · `spacing2xl` 48 (dp).

### Radii
`radiusSm` 8 dp (inputs, chips) · `radiusMd` 16 dp (cards, bubbles) · `radiusLg` 24 dp (sheets, modals) · `radiusFull` 999 dp (avatars, pills).

### Elevation
`elevation1` — `0 1px 3px rgba(36,31,25,.08)` (cards at rest) · `elevation2` — `0 4px 16px rgba(36,31,25,.14)` (sheets, modals).

### Icons
Phosphor library, Regular style, 24 dp: `list`, `plus`, `magnifying-glass`, `funnel`, `bookmark-simple`, `microphone`, `camera`, `gear`, `kanban`, `notebook`, `fingerprint`, `lightbulb` (and others used on specific screens: `check`, `warning-circle`, `wifi-slash`, `circle-notch`, `caret-left`, `download-simple`, `pencil-simple`, `x`, `stop`, `image`, `check-circle`, `chart-line-up`, `backspace`, `lock-key`, `paper-plane-tilt`, `chat-circle-text`).

### Spine (colored bar on the left of a card) — 3 contexts
1. Proactive insight in the chat — ochre.
2. Entry origin in "Meus Registros" — color by type: manual = dark green, audio = olive green, photo = gray, chat = ochre.
3. Kanban column in "Planos de Ação" — color by column **[ext]**.

### Micro-animations and transitions
- `scrimIn` (0.18 s ease-out): fade of the darkened background when any overlay opens.
- `sheetUp` (0.2 s ease-out): bottom sheets (insertion modal, filter, export) rise from the bottom of the screen.
- Continuous spinner (`spin`, 1 s linear infinite) in every loading state.
- Text streaming: the AI response is revealed progressively, with a blinking cursor at the end while it is "typing".
- PIN: after the 4th digit, a 350 ms pause before navigating.

---

## 4. Special states that need extra care

- **Expired session:** an overlay on the chat that keeps history and scroll position — the expired token must not discard the conversation state in memory before re-authentication. Re-authenticating goes back to the Biometria screen, not to a full form.
- **Offline:** blocks **sending new messages** (send icon disabled, explanatory banner), but **history stays visible and navigable**. The prototype does not show what happens to the insertion modal (text/audio/photo) when offline.
- **Asynchronous processing — audio transcription:** a loading state (spinner + frozen waveform) and two outcomes (success/error); the error always offers "Tentar novamente" and never loses the recorded audio.
- **Asynchronous processing — photo OCR:** same pattern as audio, with one extra exit on error: "Salvar só a foto", which saves the record even without extracted text.
- **Asynchronous processing — export:** two loading stages (preparing → generating the AI summary) before the result; on error, the raw data is always available for download — the failure is isolated to the AI narrative, never to the user's data.
- **Dashboard narrative unavailable:** the chart loads normally but the AI summary paragraph fails — distinct from "zero entries" (lack of data) and needs its own error message.

---

## 5. Implementation notes

1. **"29 frames" vs. "32 states":** the prototype has 32 distinct navigable states, but the number of frames (29) suggests that some state families should be one screen with internal state, not separate routes (e.g., a single `ExportSheet` with a status enum instead of 5 routes). Consider this when designing navigation.
2. **Account deletion without a success screen:** both "Sair" and "Apagar tudo" return to the Biometria screen; there is no "account deleted" or "you signed out" screen.
3. **Login vs. sign-up:** the same screen toggled by a text link; the prototype shows no extra sign-up fields (e.g., password confirmation, name). Whether sign-up needs extra fields is a product decision not covered visually.
4. **Insertion modal when offline:** not represented.
5. **Switching tabs in the insertion modal:** opening the modal always resets every tab to `idle`/empty, but switching tabs *during* a modal session is not cleared automatically — the expected behavior (e.g., whether an ongoing recording is discarded on tab switch) is not defined by the prototype.
6. **Per-entry sync indicator:** the states "sincronizado / sincronizando / erro de sync" exist visually on the cards, but no explicit "retry sync" action is shown for the error state. The semantics of the badge are in `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`.
7. **Text search combined with filters:** the filter sheet and the text search are on the same screen, but the prototype does not show them acting together.

4	/// `chat.messages.list`'s own `status` enum (`openapi.yaml:1198-1203`) —
5	/// the exact 3 states RF04's own Acceptance Criteria names
6	/// ("processing/streaming, error, complete"), reused verbatim here rather
7	/// than a second near-duplicate enum: [ChatMessageStatus.failed] is this
8	/// story's "error" state, [ChatMessageStatus.streaming] its
9	/// "processing/streaming" state.
10	enum ChatMessageStatus { streaming, complete, failed }

12	/// A persisted chat message — `chat.messages.list`'s own response `data`
13	/// item (`openapi.yaml:1180-1218`), modeled 1:1. A plain value type, no
14	/// `freezed` (same rationale as [ChatSession]/`Entry`), but with a
15	/// `copyWith` — unlike those two, this entity's [content]/[status] mutate
16	/// repeatedly as a streaming response grows (`ChatCubit`'s own append-only
17	/// message list rebuilds entries of this exact shape on every `token`
18	/// event).
19	class ChatMessage {
20	  const ChatMessage({
21	    required this.id,
22	    required this.sessionId,
23	    required this.role,
24	    required this.content,
25	    required this.seq,

54	      identical(this, other) ||
55	      (other is ChatMessage &&

57	          other.sessionId == sessionId &&
58	          other.role == role &&
59	          other.content == content &&
60	          other.seq == seq &&

1	import '../../../../core/failure/failure.dart';
2	import '../../domain/entities/chat_message.dart';
3	import '../../domain/entities/chat_session.dart';
4	
5	/// `ChatCubit`'s own sealed state — AD-12: "Chat's state is its own sealed
6	/// class, never forced into `Resource<T>`", because it isn't a single
7	/// fetch (the append-only [ChatReady.messages] list keeps growing one
8	/// token at a time while a response streams in, long after the initial
9	/// bootstrap fetch that produced it has already resolved).
10	sealed class ChatState {
11	  const ChatState();
12	}
13	
14	/// The initial state, and the state while `ChatCubit.init()`'s own
15	/// session-bootstrap (list-or-create-one-session) + history fetch are
16	/// still in flight.
17	class ChatBootstrapLoading extends ChatState {
18	  const ChatBootstrapLoading();
19	}
20	
21	/// I/O matrix: "Bootstrap failure" — `chat-sessions-list`/`create` (or the
22	/// history fetch right after) failed; the screen shows this generic error
23	/// state instead of spinning forever.
24	class ChatBootstrapError extends ChatState {
25	  const ChatBootstrapError(this.failure);
26	
27	  final Failure failure;
28	
29	  @override
30	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
31	      identical(this, other) ||
32	      (other is ChatBootstrapError && other.failure == failure);
33	
34	  @override
35	  int get hashCode => failure.hashCode;
36	}
37	
38	/// The composer is enabled, [messages] renders — [ChatUiMessage]'s own
39	/// [ChatUiMessage.status] drives each bubble's one of the 3 visible states
40	/// (streaming/failed/complete, RF04's Acceptance Criteria).
41	class ChatReady extends ChatState {
42	  const ChatReady({
43	    required this.sessionId,
44	    required this.messages,
45	    required this.sessions,
46	    this.isSending = false,
47	    this.restoreScrollOffset,
48	    this.isOffline = false,
49	  });
50	
51	  final String sessionId;
52	
53	  /// Append-only for the lifetime of this cubit (Code Map) — a message is
54	  /// ever only added to the end, or mutated in place by id (a streaming
55	  /// AI bubble's own `content`/`status`), never removed or reordered.
56	  final List<ChatUiMessage> messages;
57	
58	  /// Every Chat Session the drawer's own "CONVERSAS" section renders
59	  /// (spec-6-2 Code Map) — populated once by `ChatCubit._bootstrap`'s own
60	  /// `listSessions()`/`createSession()` call, then kept current by
61	  /// `ChatCubit.startNewSession` prepending its own result. Never
62	  /// re-fetched/paginated past that first page (Boundaries: "Never:
63	  /// paginating past the backend's default first page").
64	  final List<ChatSession> sessions;
65	
66	  /// Whether `ChatCubit.sendMessage`'s own send is actively in flight —
67	  /// the composer's one enable/disable signal (`_ChatComposer`). Kept as
68	  /// its own field rather than derived by scanning [messages] for a
69	  /// persisted `streaming` status: a message restored from history/cache
70	  /// can legitimately carry that status without a send being in flight
71	  /// (I/O matrix: mid-stream drop), which would otherwise permanently
72	  /// disable the composer.
73	  final bool isSending;
74	
75	  /// The scroll offset `ChatScreen` should jump to the moment this exact
76	  /// [ChatReady] becomes the active session (spec-6-2 I/O matrix: "Switch
77	  /// session") — `ChatCubit._scrollOffsets[sessionId]`'s own last
78	  /// recorded value, or `null` when none was ever recorded (a brand new
79	  /// session, or a session visited for the first time this app run),
80	  /// which `ChatScreen` reads as "jump to bottom instead" (Code Map).
81	  /// Deliberately never cleared by the cubit itself once set — `ChatScreen`
82	  /// only consults it the instant [sessionId] changes from the previous
83	  /// state it observed, so a later unrelated emit (e.g. a streamed token)
84	  /// carrying the same value forward via [copyWith] is harmless (Design
85	  /// Notes).
86	  final double? restoreScrollOffset;
87	
88	  /// spec-6-3 — whether the device currently has no connectivity
89	  /// (`ChatCubit`'s own `ConnectivityWatcher` subscription), `false` by
90	  /// default (bootstrap's own first guess, before any connectivity
91	  /// reading has ever arrived). Drives `_ChatComposer.canSend`, the
92	  /// offline banner between `_ChatHeader` and the message list, and
93	  /// `AppDrawer`'s "Novo Chat" gate — additive only (Boundaries): never
94	  /// changes `ChatRepositoryImpl`'s own existing reactive
95	  /// `Failure.networkOffline` handling.
96	  final bool isOffline;
97	
98	  ChatReady copyWith({
99	    List<ChatUiMessage>? messages,
100	    List<ChatSession>? sessions,
101	    bool? isSending,
102	    double? restoreScrollOffset,
103	    bool? isOffline,
104	  }) => ChatReady(
105	    sessionId: sessionId,
106	    messages: messages ?? this.messages,
107	    sessions: sessions ?? this.sessions,
108	    isSending: isSending ?? this.isSending,
109	    restoreScrollOffset: restoreScrollOffset ?? this.restoreScrollOffset,
110	    isOffline: isOffline ?? this.isOffline,
111	  );
112	}
113	
114	/// One bubble's own presentation-layer shape — distinct from the domain
115	/// `ChatMessage` entity (Code Map) because a message in flight has no
116	/// server-assigned `seq`/`retryCount`/`createdAt` yet; [id] is a locally
117	/// generated, UI-only identifier (`ChatCubit._nextLocalId()`), never the
118	/// server's own message id (Design Notes: `message_created`'s id is the
119	/// *user* message's server id, unused by this story — see
120	/// `ChatStreamEvent`'s own doc).
121	class ChatUiMessage {
122	  const ChatUiMessage({
123	    required this.id,
124	    required this.role,
125	    required this.content,
126	    required this.status,
127	    this.serverId,
128	  });

130	  final String id;
131	  final ChatMessageRole role;
132	  final String content;
133	  final ChatMessageStatus status;
134	
135	  /// spec-6-3 Design Notes: "`serverId` (not reusing `id`) avoids ever
136	  /// swapping a `ChatUiMessage.id` mid-stream" — the backend-assigned id
137	  /// this message is persisted under, known from the moment it's loaded
138	  /// from history/cache (`ChatCubit._fromDomain`), or captured mid-session
139	  /// off the SSE `message_created` event once/if it arrives
140	  /// (`ChatCubit._applyStreamEvent`). `null` for a just-sent message whose
141	  /// stream hasn't delivered `message_created` yet (or ever, on a very
142	  /// early drop) — the one value [ChatCubit.retryMessage] reads off the
143	  /// user message preceding a `failed` AI bubble to decide whether it can
144	  /// call `chat-messages-retry` at all (Boundaries: "Never calling
145	  /// `chat-messages-retry` with no `serverId`").
146	  final String? serverId;
147	
148	  ChatUiMessage copyWith({
149	    String? content,
150	    ChatMessageStatus? status,
151	    String? serverId,
152	  }) => ChatUiMessage(
153	    id: id,
154	    role: role,
155	    content: content ?? this.content,
156	    status: status ?? this.status,
157	    serverId: serverId ?? this.serverId,
158	  );
159	
160	  @override
161	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
162	      identical(this, other) ||
163	      (other is ChatUiMessage &&
164	          other.id == id &&
165	          other.role == role &&
166	          other.content == content &&
167	          other.status == status &&
168	          other.serverId == serverId);
169	
170	  @override
171	  int get hashCode => Object.hash(id, role, content, status, serverId);
172	
173	  @override
174	  String toString() =>
175	      'ChatUiMessage(id: $id, role: $role, content: $content, '

13	/// bottom-right corner) vs AI (`colorSurfaceElevated`, squared bottom-left
14	/// corner, resting [DesignTokens.elevation1]). Exactly the 3 visible
15	/// states RF04's Acceptance Criteria names render here, driven by
16	/// [ChatUiMessage.status]: `streaming` (progressive text + blinking
17	/// cursor), `failed` (spec-6-3: a tappable tap-to-retry indicator replaces
18	/// the timestamp slot, invoking [onRetry]), `complete` (plain text,
19	/// nothing else). [ChatUiMessage.content] itself is rendered as-is in
20	/// every state — never cleared on failure (I/O matrix).
21	class ChatBubble extends StatefulWidget {
22	  const ChatBubble({required this.message, this.onRetry, super.key});
23	
24	  final ChatUiMessage message;
25	
26	  /// spec-6-3 — invoked when the user taps a `failed` AI bubble's own
27	  /// retry copy; `null` on a user bubble (never shown there, only an AI
28	  /// response ever fails) or whenever a caller has nothing to wire it to.
29	  final VoidCallback? onRetry;
30	
31	  @override
32	  State<ChatBubble> createState() => _ChatBubbleState();
33	}
34	
35	class _ChatBubbleState extends State<ChatBubble>
36	    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
37	  late final AnimationController _cursorController;
38	
39	  @override
40	  void initState() {
41	    super.initState();
42	    _cursorController = AnimationController(
43	      vsync: this,
44	      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 600),
45	    );
46	    _syncCursorAnimation();
47	  }
48	
49	  @override
50	  void didUpdateWidget(ChatBubble oldWidget) {
51	    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
52	    _syncCursorAnimation();
53	  }
54	
55	  /// Keeps the ticker running only while actually needed — a message
56	  /// that finalizes to `complete`/`failed` must stop ticking forever
57	  /// after, both so a long-lived chat session never leaks one live
58	  /// `AnimationController` per past message, and so nothing waiting on
59	  /// "every animation in the tree has settled" (e.g. a test's own
60	  /// `pumpAndSettle()`) ever blocks on a bubble that finished streaming.
61	  void _syncCursorAnimation() {
62	    final shouldAnimate = widget.message.status == ChatMessageStatus.streaming;
63	    if (shouldAnimate && !_cursorController.isAnimating) {
64	      _cursorController.repeat(reverse: true);
65	    } else if (!shouldAnimate && _cursorController.isAnimating) {
66	      _cursorController.stop();
67	    }
68	  }
69	
70	  @override

72	    _cursorController.dispose();
73	    super.dispose();
74	  }

78	    final message = widget.message;
79	    final onRetry = widget.onRetry;
80	    final isUser = message.role == ChatMessageRole.user;
81	    // Boundaries: "cursor skipped under
82	    // `MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations`" — the real token text
83	    // itself always reveals as real tokens actually arrive (there is no
84	    // separate typing-speed animation to collapse here), only the
85	    // blinking-cursor glyph is conditional on Reduce Motion.
86	    final reduceMotion = MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations;

109	            child: Text(

112	                color: DesignTokens.colorError,
113	              ),
114	            ),
115	          ),
116	        ),
117	      ),
118	    );
119	    final retryIndicatorWithSemantics = onRetry == null
120	        ? retryIndicator
121	        : Semantics(
122	            button: true,
123	            label: _retryCopy,
124	            excludeSemantics: true,
125	            child: retryIndicator,
126	          );
127	
128	    // Correction: `cerne-prototype.html`'s own bubble markup puts this
129	    // `IBM Plex Mono`/`colorTextSecondary` caption *below* the bubble, on
130	    // every message — a previous pass never rendered it at all. "agora"
131	    // ([ChatUiMessage.createdAt]'s own doc) for a message with no server
132	    // timestamp yet; otherwise the server `createdAt`'s local wall-clock
133	    // time, `HH:mm` (same parse-for-display convention
134	    // `entry_record_card.dart`'s own `_formatTime` already uses — a
135	    // malformed timestamp falls back to the same "agora" placeholder
136	    // rather than throwing, RNF09).
137	    final timeCaption = Text(
138	      _formatTime(message.createdAt),
139	      style: DesignTokens.textMonoCaption.copyWith(
140	        color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
141	      ),
142	    );

145	      alignment: isUser ? Alignment.centerRight : Alignment.centerLeft,
146	      child: ConstrainedBox(
147	        constraints: BoxConstraints(

151	        ),

200	              if (message.status == ChatMessageStatus.failed)
201	                retryIndicatorWithSemantics
202	              else

212	/// [ChatBubble]'s own timestamp caption — `createdAt`'s local wall-clock
213	/// time, `HH:mm`, or "agora" for a message with no server timestamp yet
214	/// ([ChatUiMessage.createdAt]'s own doc) or one that fails to parse
215	/// (RNF09: never throws on a malformed value), same defensive shape
216	/// `entry_record_card.dart`'s own `_formatTime` already uses.
217	String _formatTime(String? createdAt) {
218	  if (createdAt == null) {
219	    return 'agora';
220	  }
221	  final local = DateTime.tryParse(createdAt)?.toLocal();
222	  if (local == null) {
223	    return 'agora';
224	  }
225	  final hour = local.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
226	  final minute = local.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
227	  return '$hour:$minute';
228	}

This all looks correct and well-formatted. Here's a summary of the four fixes:

1. **Failure note band** — [chat_bubble.dart](lib/features/chat/presentation/widgets/chat_bubble.dart): restructured the bubble so the bubble's colored/shadowed `Container` holds only the message text; the retry note (or time caption) now renders as a plain sibling *below* it, with the `colorErrorBg` background decoration removed entirely — matching the prototype's bare `<span>`.
2. **Missing timestamps** — added `ChatUiMessage.createdAt` ([chat_state.dart](lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart)), populated from history in `ChatCubit._fromDomain`, and `ChatBubble` now renders it as an `IBM Plex Mono`/`colorTextSecondary` caption under every bubble — "agora" for a message with no server timestamp yet (optimistic sends have none, matching the prototype's own placeholder), `HH:mm` otherwise.
3. **Composer bar** — [chat_screen.dart](lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart): wrapped it in a `Container` with `colorSurfaceElevated` fill and a `colorBorder` top divider, matching the prototype's `background:#FBF9F4;border-top:1px solid #E1DACB`.
4. **Send icon** — swapped `Icons.send` for `Icons.send_outlined` (the outline variant matching the prototype's Phosphor `ph-paper-plane-tilt` Regular style); updated the 5 test references accordingly.

Also corrected `design_tokens.dart`'s stale doc comment on `chatFailureIndicatorPadding` (it's tap-target padding only now, never paired with a background fill). Full suite: 971/971 passing, `flutter analyze` clean.

182	  Future<void> _startNewSession(BuildContext context) async {

361	          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
362	            horizontal: DesignTokens.spacingXs,
363	            vertical: DesignTokens.spacingSm,
364	          ),
365	          child: Text(
366	            'CONVERSAS',
367	            style: DesignTokens.textMonoCaption.copyWith(
368	              color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
369	            ),
370	          ),
371	        ),
372	        for (final session in sorted)
373	          _DrawerSessionItem(
374	            session: session,
375	            isActive: session.id == activeSessionId,
376	            onTap: () => onSelect(session.id),
377	          ),
378	      ],
379	    );
380	  }
381	}
382	
383	/// One "CONVERSAS" row — [_DrawerNavItem]'s own tokens reused verbatim
384	/// (Boundaries: "no new design tokens"), plus a trailing mono timestamp
385	/// (prototype: "title + timestamp").
386	class _DrawerSessionItem extends StatelessWidget {
387	  const _DrawerSessionItem({
388	    required this.session,
389	    required this.isActive,
390	    required this.onTap,
391	  });
392	
393	  final ChatSession session;
394	  final bool isActive;
395	  final VoidCallback onTap;
396	
397	  @override
398	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
399	    // Boundaries: "An empty `title` renders fallback label 'Nova
400	    // conversa'" (the contract leaves an untitled session's `title`
401	    // undocumented).
402	    final title = session.title.trim().isEmpty
403	        ? 'Nova conversa'
404	        : session.title;
405	    return InkWell(
406	      onTap: onTap,
407	      child: Padding(
408	        padding: DesignTokens.drawerNavItemPadding,
409	        child: Row(
410	          children: [
411	            Expanded(
412	              child: Text(
413	                title,
414	                maxLines: 1,
415	                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
416	                style: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(
417	                  color: isActive
418	                      ? DesignTokens.colorPrimary
419	                      : DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary,
420	                ),
421	              ),
422	            ),
423	            const SizedBox(width: DesignTokens.spacingSm),
424	            Text(
425	              _formatSessionTimestamp(session.updatedAt),
426	              style: DesignTokens.textMonoCaption.copyWith(
427	                color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
428	              ),
429	            ),
430	          ],
431	        ),
432	      ),
433	    );
434	  }
435	}
436	
437	/// `updatedAt`'s local wall-clock time, `HH:mm` — same presentation-only
438	/// parse-for-display convention and `'--:--'` malformed-input fallback as
439	/// `entry_record_card.dart`'s own `_formatTime` (RNF09: never throws).
440	String _formatSessionTimestamp(String updatedAt) {
441	  final local = DateTime.tryParse(updatedAt)?.toLocal();
442	  if (local == null) {
443	    return '--:--';
444	  }
445	  final hour = local.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
446	  final minute = local.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
447	  return '$hour:$minute';
448	}

432	/// `updatedAt`'s local wall-clock time, `HH:mm` — same presentation-only
433	/// parse-for-display convention and `'--:--'` malformed-input fallback as
434	/// `entry_record_card.dart`'s own `_formatTime` (RNF09: never throws).
435	String _formatSessionTimestamp(String updatedAt) {
436	  final local = DateTime.tryParse(updatedAt)?.toLocal();
437	  if (local == null) {
438	    return '--:--';
439	  }
440	  final hour = local.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
441	  final minute = local.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
442	  return '$hour:$minute';

## Summary

**Item (1) — real signed-in identity — left as-is, per your call.** deferred-work.md already documents this as explicitly out of scope for a visual fix: no display name exists anywhere yet, and even the login email isn't persisted today, so wiring it for real needs new `AccessTokenProvider` methods, a `SessionRepository` accessor, and `AuthRepositoryImpl` changes — scoped to Epic 8. The generic avatar/"Usuário" placeholder stays.

Items (2)–(5), fixed in [app_drawer.dart](lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart):

- **(2) Order** — "Novo Chat" now renders *inside* `_ConversasSection`, directly below the "CONVERSAS" label and above the session rows, matching the prototype's nesting (previously it was a pinned sibling above the whole scrollable section).
- **(3) Timestamp placement** — `_DrawerSessionItem` is now a `Column` (title, then a 2dp gap, then the mono timestamp) instead of a trailing `Row` item. Added `DesignTokens.drawerSessionItemGap` (2dp, off the 4dp scale) for the gap.
- **(4) Active-title color** — removed the `isActive`/`colorPrimary` highlight entirely; the prototype's own markup never colors the active session's title differently, so every row now renders in plain `colorTextPrimary`.
- **(5) Icon** — swapped `Icons.menu_book_outlined` (open book) for `Icons.note_outlined` for "Meus Registros," a closer, lighter match for the prototype's `ph-notebook`. Left "Planos de Ação"/"Configurações" icons unchanged — they're already the outline variants, and I found no concrete basis in the prototype markup for swapping them.

All 971 tests pass (updated `app_drawer_test.dart` wasn't touched — its assertions are text/behavior-based and didn't depend on the old structure), `flutter analyze` is clean.
